newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to cruise, need to retake 101.10.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to cruise, need to retake 101.10.

text.p: September Bund futures on LIFFE will cruise in neutral on Wednesday after uninspiring price action in the previous session, analysts said.
On Friday and Monday the contract broke through a steep uptrend but posted an inside day on Tuesday, signalling some consolidation was in order, they said.
"We broke a very aggressive uptrend and will have a slight consolidation here," said Oliver Boetger, senior associate director at DMG Futures & Options in Frankfurt.
Bunds were down 0.02 at 100.87 at 0656 GMT.
Resistance around there stems from Tuesday's high at 100.92 and Monday's high at 101.10, he said.
A trader at a British bank agreed resistance there was the key to further gains.
"Bunds look a little sick this morning after yesterday's inside day showed a loss of momentum,' he said. "If they want to stage a recovery they need to break above 101.10."
To the downside, analysts said there was several layers of support at 100.80, 100.70 and around 100.60, from recent lows with Tuesday's low at 100.69 pivotal.
EMU concerns continued to rankle the market, the trader said
He said customers have move into dollar products from Bunds.
At the short end, December Euromarks were quoted at 96.72, unchanged from Tuesday's session while September were also flat at 96.82.

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said in a research note good support had developed for the September contract which would allow it to challenge strong resistance over 96.80.
Adcock said first resistance comes in at 96.83 this session, which daily charts show as the high on February 19 before the contract drifted down.
